_comment: Trade and money. Several start market events, so what you hear here moves real prices. See docs/events.md.

glut_news.title: News of a glut
glut_news.text: A passing sloop hails with news: {port} is drowning in its own produce. The warehouses are full and prices have collapsed.

choices.result: Cheap cargo in {port}, for anyone quick enough.

harvest_failure.title: A failed harvest
harvest_failure.text: Merchants in {here} talk of nothing else: blight has ruined the crop around {port}. Prices there will go through the roof.

choices.result: Whatever {port} grows will be scarce, and dear.

warehouse_fire_news.title: Fire in {port}
warehouse_fire_news.text: Word comes that a fire has gutted the warehouses of {port}. They'll pay anything for what they've lost.

choices.result: Anything {port} imports will fetch a fortune for a while.

rotten_cargo.title: Spoiled cargo
rotten_cargo.text: Seawater has got into the hold. The {good} is spoiling.

choices.result: Five units over the side. The rest is saved.

choices.text: Dry it on deck and hope
choices.result: Two days of sun saves it all.
choices.fail_result: A squall soaks it all again. You lose more than you saved.

speculator.title: A sure thing
speculator.text: A smooth merchant in {port} offers you a share in a cargo of {good} bound for Europe. Put in 200 now, {merchant} says, and collect 400 in a month.

choices.result: There is no ship. There is no cargo. You walk away.

speculator_return.title: The cargo of {good}
speculator_return.text: You go looking for {merchant} and your 400 gold.

choices.result: The cargo sold well in Cádiz. {merchant} pays you 400, with a flourish.
choices.fail_result: The ship was lost, {merchant} says, with a very straight face. You'll never see that money again.

counterfeit_coin.title: Bad coin
counterfeit_coin.text: Your purser bites a coin from the last sale and spits. Lead, washed in silver. A good share of your money is false.

choices.text: Sort it out and throw the bad coin away
Pass it on at the next port

buyer_at_sea.title: A buyer at sea
buyer_at_sea.text: A Dutch trader runs alongside. He knows stolen cargo when he sees it, and offers to take your {good} off your hands, here and now, no questions.

choices.result: Quick money, and the evidence is gone.

choices.fail_result: He gets bored and sails off.

choices.result: You'll get a better price in Nassau.

merchant_partnership.title: A merchant's proposal
merchant_partnership.text: {merchant}, a merchant of {port}, has watched you trade. The offer: your ship on the merchant's books, cargo on credit, a share of the profit.

choices.text: Accept a first cargo on credit
choices.result: Twenty of {good}, on account. Sell it well.

choices.text: You prefer to stay your own master

guild_fee.title: The merchants' guild
guild_fee.text: The merchants of {port} want a fee from every foreign captain who trades here. Refuse, and they'll make sure nobody buys from you.

choices.text: Tell them where to put their fee
choices.result: You'll find the prices here a little less friendly.
